description: Ponto de carregamento de veículos elétricos is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . Localização dos pontos de carregamento de veículos elétricos na cidade de Águeda. Coverage:  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . The publisher named on the listing is  Câmara Municipal de Águeda . Its keywords include mobilidade, veiculos, ecologia, dadosabertos-cm-agueda-pt. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GPKG, WMS, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
